points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Eight workspace packages structurally validate, but Re200 periodic/target-success metadata contradicts final strict ratio and force trajectory. output.cpp:107–109 hardcodes surface cf=0; recovered laminar and cylinder rows confirm zeros.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Previously recorded validator passes eight packages and report; structural checks do not verify physical convergence or inner-target semantics.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 final Cd8.86975, Cl−0.38716; Re200 t180–300 Cd21.012..21.238, Cl3.745..3.830, with no visible shedding.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Selected final response and manifest deliver 41 figures; force plots inspected, but Re200 captions assert absent shedding and several steady drag plots compress late behavior.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Seven-page delivered PDF is readable, but nested force_table floats generate LaTeX errors and omit both numeric and rank tables. Captions claim Re200 shedding although force history shows slow drift; figure/manifest attribution remains partial.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Workspace figure manifest identifies source files; immutable force_table.tex contains numeric results but nested floats prevent its rendering in delivered PDF. Rank comparisons use unequal endpoints and no recorded binary revision.
